summary.name: Hug In Heaven AI
summary.one_liner: A paid AI tool that turns two adult photos into a ~12–15 second vertical 9:16 memorial video of a stairway reunion in heaven, with soft piano and strings.
keywords: day of the dead ai video
use_cases: Making a memorial tribute video for a deceased family member
Creating a Day of the Dead remembrance clip
Producing a vertical video to share on social media as a tribute
Birthday or anniversary tribute for a loved one who has died
Making a one-off AI memorial clip without installing an app
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes two photos of adults (one of the user in life and one of the loved one) and generates a roughly 12–15 second 9:16 MP4 showing a stairway reunion in light, with a soft original piano and strings score. The page states output is 720p, with a 480p option at a lower credit cost. Users upload photos, confirm permission, and wait about 5–15 minutes for a watermark-free download. The page describes the scene as an AI-generated tribute, not documentary footage, and says the prompt is a locked catalog prompt that users cannot edit. It also lists a single-photo upload check and rules against photos of children.
notable: Two-photo input producing a ~12–15s 9:16 stairway reunion memorial video
Pay-per-video credit packs from $8.88 with no subscription or account required
Explicit 18+ only policy: adults only, no children or public figures
caveats: Paid: single video $8.88 (720p), packs at $16.99 for 3 and $29.90 for 10
Only adults 18+ may be depicted; photos of children are not accepted
Download links expire, and generated output is AI-created rather than documentary
